newsitem.title: USA: HEI Inc shares off on contract phase-out.
newsitem.headline: HEI Inc shares off on contract phase-out.

text.p: Shares of HEI Inc dropped 3-5/16 to 4-1/2 after the company said it received notice from its largest current customer to begin phasing out production of a microelectronic assembly used in high density disk drives.
R.J. Steichen analyst Ernest Andberg said the contract phase-out was sudden, adding his earnings estimates for HEI are currently under review.
"When the disk drive business is going at full volume, it can be as much as half of (HEI's) business," Andberg said.
Andberg added that HEI had been working to establish other customer relationships to help offset this major contract.
He said the contract was expected to be phased out at some point because of the inherent volatility of the disk drive business.
